documents.AGENTS.md:
# Project instructions

Use the existing knowledge/ layout.
Production publication requires owner approval.
Use Approved, Proposed and Unknown as decision statuses.

## Context Docs maintenance

Use $context-docs for documentation audits and after meaningful changes to
project facts, decisions, procedures, blockers or next actions. Read the installed
skill before maintenance. Start at [Current context](knowledge/state.md) and
preserve the knowledge/ layout, project rules, document roles and decision statuses.
Update affected canonical sections and check the diff, links and information
preservation, including uncommitted material. Keep audit-only requests read-only;
make no bookkeeping edits when nothing durable changed.

Method: context-docs
Adopted: 2026-10-01
Entry point: knowledge/state.md
